working_rules: Stable shared-parameter GUIDs must not be regenerated once formally published.
Use type parameters for values intended to remain identical across all occurrences of a type; use instance parameters for placement/context-specific values.
Do not include organization, client or project names in reusable shared-parameter names.
Do not encode units in names unless required to disambiguate meaning; store units in the data type and presentation configuration where possible.
Deprecated parameters should retain traceability to their replacement rather than being silently removed from legacy models.

provenance.migration_note: Parameter examples retained as working reference only. GUIDs and exact bindings remain unresolved until backed by the governed parameter registry. Organization, client and project identifiers removed.
